meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Basic Statistical Return 2 (via DBIE)
meta.revisionPolicy: BSR-2 stocks are final on release for the year; the sector classification changed in 2018-19 and the deposit-size bands in March 2026 (both disclosed, never spliced).
meta.coverage: Bank deposits by every owning sector of the old classification (codes 1 to 53: government, companies, financial firms, farmers, wage earners, traders, trusts, foreign sector...) and by type of account, March 2003 to March 2018, ₹ crore
meta.note: RBI BSR-2 via DBIE report 737, sector codes 1 to 53 (the classification used to March 2018). Never joined to the SNA-based classification that starts in March 2019 (deposits-sectors).
